notes.content:

Major new features:
- Selectable quality preset (Ultra Low, Low, Medium, High, Ultra)
- Selectable screen resolution (and refresh rate)
- Turrets now have a laser that points where they are aiming

notes.title: Full Gamepad Support!!!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I am happy to announce that a new update as been release, you can expect the following changes:

- Added full Gamepad support
- New type of door that can be opened by activating a pressure plate via an energy cube
- Minor changes and bug fixes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104880/16b4834f74bd6b0991c178f1e9d8d51e3f40aa30.png[/img]

Now you can navigate all menus with a gamepad, no keyboard or mouse needed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104880/a584689746aa009501809706e94145315aa4f600.png[/img]

Now some doors will be opened only by activating the pressure plate with an energy cube

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104880/f02b5cb2c58c2db0c8e14e5815b5b0d6353f0506.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104880/b1807fd48c95c051e19b822616ef2ac88e932c64.png[/img][/url]
Gamepad (default button behavior)

Thank you all for testing, stay safe and have fun!

notes.title: Better AI
notes.content:
Hi everyone, in this update you can expect chages like:

- Enemies follows the player only if there is "line of sight" (including turrets ːp2turretː) 
- Improved camera system (better animations)
- New level (still WIP)
- Changed enemy shield behavior, now it can be disable for a few seconds after taking 5 "damage points"
- Mainly bug fixes and code improvements

I aim to release the full level in the next update to better test the game mechanics and test different play styles, until then... have fun and have a good day! ːLIS_pixel_heartː

notes.title: New update coming soon...
notes.content:
Hello everyone, monthly update news here!

Development is still in progress and new enemies and features are coming in the next update.

Say hello to our new friend!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104880/9a3aec3394bf7d7df6af99520e4efacbee969760.png[/img]
(W.I.P.)

The "Drone" companion (not final name btw) will help you hunt every cube you will encounter (except friendly of course, yes there will be friendly cubes in the future).
Now you can also buy supplies and upgrades at the new vending machine using your xp points.

And of course the new enemies:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104880/1428c7a666f91a25fe6d816d91f32775943b766b.png[/img]
(Also W.I.P)

The very first "Boss" of the game, armed with 2 cannons and with a lot of health is very angry at you for a yet unknown reason, and his little friend, the little cube in front of him is a new type of enemy and it will come with many more little friends just to annoy the player ("very lovely" indeed)


Other small changes:
The text of the "Fullscreen" option has been corrected from "fulscreen" to "fullscreen"

notes.title: New update: Grab mode has been completely reworked
notes.content:
Hello everyone, a new update as been released!!!

The new update contains some bug fixes and a completely reworked "Grab Mode" mechanic.

Changes:
-Grab mode has been completely reworked to fix all the bugs it previously had 
-Destructible objects are now "Kinematic" until an explosive cube interacts with them 
-Minor bug fixes

If you find any bugs or problems you can report them in the "Discussions" page of the game
